MATCH (p:Person {firstName:"Frank", lastName:"Jones"})-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:Organisation:University)
RETURN u.name

MATCH (p:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(c:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(co:Country {name: 'Uruguay'})
RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS peopleCount

MATCH (p:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(c:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(co:Country)
WHERE (p.firstName = 'Aisso' AND p.lastName = 'Caveda') OR (p.firstName + ' ' + p.lastName = 'Aisso Caveda')
RETURN co.name

MATCH (p1:Person {firstName:'Hsin', lastName:'Chiang'}), (p2:Person {firstName:'Ganesh', lastName:'Bombo'})
MATCH p=shortestPath((p1)-[:KNOWS*]-(p2))
RETURN length(p) AS shortestFriendshipLength

MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE p.creationDate.year = 2009 AND p.creationDate.month = 12
RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS numPeople

MATCH (p:Person {firstName:"Ashley", lastName:"Coetzee"})-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:Organisation:University)
RETURN u.name

MATCH (p:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(c:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(co:Country {name: 'Slovakia'})
RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS numPeople

MATCH (p:Person {firstName:'Abdullah', lastName:'Arikan'})-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(country:Country)
RETURN country.name

MATCH (p1:Person), (p2:Person)
WHERE ((p1.firstName = 'Ferenc' AND p1.lastName = 'Nagy') OR (p1.firstName + ' ' + p1.lastName = 'Ferenc Nagy'))
  AND ((p2.firstName = 'Jae-Jin' AND p2.lastName = 'Park') OR (p2.firstName + ' ' + p2.lastName = 'Jae-Jin Park'))
WITH p1, p2
MATCH path = shortestPath((p1)-[:KNOWS*]-(p2))
RETURN length(path) AS friendshipSteps

MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE p.creationDate.year = 2012 AND p.creationDate.month = 11
RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS accountsCreatedInNov2012

MATCH (p:Person {firstName: 'Boris', lastName: 'Sheik'})
RETURN p.birthday

MATCH (p:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag {name: "Tilda_Swinton"})
RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS postCount

MATCH (p:Person {firstName:'Wojciech', lastName:'Kowalski'})-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(c:City)
MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]-(f:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(c)
WHERE f <> p
RETURN DISTINCT f.firstName, f.lastName

MATCH (f:Person {firstName:'Fernando', lastName:'Alarcón'}), 
      (d:Person {firstName:'Donald', lastName:'Munro'}), 
      (m:Person)-[:KNOWS]-(f), 
      (m)-[:KNOWS]-(d)
WHERE m <> f AND m <> d
RETURN DISTINCT m.firstName, m.lastName

MATCH (c:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)
WHERE p.firstName + ' ' + p.lastName = 'Ahmad Shah Aman'
  AND c.creationDate.year = 2011
  AND c.creationDate.quarter = 4
RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS commentCount

MATCH (p:Person {firstName: 'Budi', lastName: 'Balawan'})
RETURN p.birthday

MATCH (p:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag {name: "There Is No Beginning to the Story"})
RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS postCount

MATCH (c:Person {firstName:'Cesar', lastName:'Gonzales'})-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City),
      (c)-[:KNOWS]-(f:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city)
WHERE f <> c
RETURN f.firstName, f.lastName
ORDER BY f.firstName, f.lastName

MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS]-(z:Person {firstName:'Zdenek', lastName:'Balcar'}),
      (p)-[:KNOWS]-(pa:Person {firstName:'Pablo', lastName:'Sanchez'})
RETURN DISTINCT p.firstName, p.lastName

MATCH (c:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)
WHERE (p.firstName = 'Mehmet' AND p.lastName = 'Tekin')
   OR (p.firstName + ' ' + p.lastName = 'Mehmet Tekin')
   AND c.creationDate.year = 2012
   AND c.creationDate.quarter = 1
RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS commentCount
